name: projects
notes: Owns projects, budget lines, tasks, supervisor assignments and the append-only cost ledger (constitution 5.11). Other modules post costs only through postCost; a status change appends a row of the same chain (the source line) and the latest row of a chain is its current state, read through the view prj_v_cost_summary. A database trigger refuses any update, delete or truncate of prj_cost_entries. Project codes come from the number series project (prefix PRJ). One project is made per accepted quotation (event quotation.accepted); contract value is the quotation price and never changes. A government project is refused unless ALLOW_GOVERNMENT_DATA=true. Supervisor assignments write project scopes through identity.users.setScopes. Work orders are refused as cost objects until the setting projects.work_orders_enabled is on (P3-02). The manual overhead journal with approval named in section 5 of the spec is not built here (see BACKLOG).
